name: Third Imperium
description: A vast, feudal-bureaucratic star empire stretching across hundreds of worlds. Power flows from the Emperor through dukes, archdukes, and counts, with the Imperial Navy and Marines enforcing order. At the frontier, the Imperium is pragmatic—expansion is slow, but influence is absolute.

name: Glitterworld Federation
description: An allaiance of different world trying to establish their own powerbase at the edge of the Third Imperium.
notes: Based on ancient rome, steeped in tradition and republic values.

name: Vor'lekai Horde
description: A disgraced Aslan, the "Claws of the Red Sands", clan stripped of their ko (landholdings) and cast out by the Tlaukhu. Now roaming the Rust Belt, they have abandoned traditional Ihatei migration patterns in favor of rapid, brutal conquest. They fight not merely for territory, but for the honor of reinstatement—or the creation of a new Hierate that remembers their name.
goals: An exiled faction from the Aslan Hierate, trying to regain their honor by expanding the power in the Rust Belt

name: Aslan Hierate
description: A confederation of 29 great clans bound by tradition, ritual, and the eternal need for land. Controlled by the Fteirle (females) in political and economic matters, while males lead war and colonization. The Hierate is not a unified state—it is a balance of competing clan interests with expansion as a cultural imperative.
